counterfactual_missing_items: No explicit histopathologic diagnosis of fibroma; biopsy wording is descriptive rather than definitive
No immunohistochemistry to exclude other spindle-cell tumors
No mention of classic fibroma collagen bundles or encapsulation
decisive_items: wide fibroblast proliferation, extremely similar to a fibroma
located deep in the left buccal space
bulge of the left buccal mucosa
response.rationale: C1 combines the only diagnostic raw biopsy span with raw anatomic localization to the buccal space, whereas R1 stops at the histologic label without the required anatomy. R2-R5 rely on nonspecific imaging or FNA features and are not supported by the fibroblastic biopsy.

rejected.why: Firm mobile non-tender mass is nonspecific; imaging shows a solid enhancing tumor and biopsy shows fibroblastic proliferation, not adipocytes.
Soft tissue tumor is a generic radiologic description, not a specific diagnosis, and lacks histologic support.
Histiocytes on FNA are nonspecific and not diagnostic; the biopsy shows fibroblast proliferation rather than a histiocytic/storiform lesion.
The mass overlies the parotid on ultrasound, but CT localizes it to the buccal space and biopsy is fibroblastic, not salivary gland tissue.
